<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

FlashInfer multi-item scoring (MIS) resets `forward_batch.positions` so each item follows the shared query independently. Qwen3.5 text models with MRoPE instead consume `forward_batch.mrope_positions`, which retains packed-sequence positions. Preceding items therefore introduce an incorrect positional gap even though the MIS attention mask hides them.

```text
Packed input:       Q0 Q1 D A0 A1 D B0 B1 D
B rotary positions:
  packed / before:  6  7
  item-local / fix: 2  3
```

Synchronize the text MRoPE tensor that the model actually consumes, without changing the existing logical MIS positions or multimodal spatial coordinates.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Mirror each MIS suffix's existing item-local positions across the three MRoPE axes only when the request has no multimodal inputs.
- Preserve logical scalar delimiter position `-1` for empty queries; clamp only the consumed MRoPE rotary-cache indices to zero.
- Preserve query-prefix positions, cached-prefix offsets, genuine multimodal coordinates, and non-MIS/decode behavior. Keep the existing on-device metadata calculation, attention-mask parameters, and GDN implementation unchanged.
- Add four synthetic CPU regression tests under `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/`, using `CustomTestCase` and `base-a-test-cpu`. Cover text position resets, empty-query index safety and delimiter exclusion, mixed requests with cached prefixes, and non-MIS no-op branches.

Compatibility: text MIS outputs on MRoPE models intentionally change. No API, flag, dependency, or persisted-data change is introduced. This is a two-way door: rollback is a revert; the blast radius is text scoring.

## Reproduction

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
  --revision 57370f0ea82c3cca33558a95212e032c344e5fd5 \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --enable-mis \
  --attention-backend flashinfer \
  --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton \
  --disable-radix-cache \
  --disable-cuda-graph \
  --chunked-prefill-size -1 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.8 \
  --language-only \
  --max-running-requests 16 \
  --max-prefill-tokens 30000 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 30000
```

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Tested on one NVIDIA H200 with `Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base` in BF16, TP1, FlashInfer full attention and Triton linear-attention prefill, using a source-matched compatibility runtime.

- Four metadata regression tests passed: query-relative text MRoPE, empty-query safe indices, mixed text/multimodal requests with cached prefixes, and non-MIS/decode no-op behavior.
- The original source fails the text-position assertions; the corrected source passes all four cases.
- Targeted formatting, import/static checks, syntax, CI registration and whitespace checks passed.

**Manual real-model validation against [HF's Qwen3.5 implementation](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.12.1/src/transformers/models/qwen3_5/modeling_qwen3_5.py#L1173-L1203):** two complete CUDA/BF16 HF forwards, without supplying position IDs, provide the independent rotary-position reference. Native SGLang captures observe the positions actually entering `fused_qk_gemma_rmsnorm_rope_gate` across all eight full-attention layers and three MRoPE axes. Only this position correction is enabled.

Keep the 32-token query and 64-token target B unchanged; vary the length of preceding item A:

| A tokens | Original B rotary start | This fix / HF reference |
|---|---:|---:|
| 4 | 38 | 32 |
| 48 | 82 | 32 |
| 256 | 290 | 32 |
| 1072 | 1106 | 32 |

- B consumes `32..95` after the fix, independent of A's length. Empty-query cases with A lengths 4 and 48 consume `0..63`; all rotary-cache indices remain nonnegative.
- The same exact-integer assertion fails on all **27,648** captured target token/axis/layer coordinates before the fix and passes on all **27,648** afterward. The separate MIS-disabled SIS control matches all **9,216** coordinates.
- **42 native scoring requests** are captured: 18 original MIS, 18 corrected MIS and 6 SIS, with three repetitions per case. Coordinate counts are not counts of independent test cases. The correctness criterion is exact equality to the observed HF positions, not a probability tolerance.

<details>
<summary>Static checks</summary>

The following commands pass with Ruff 0.15.1 and isort 7.0.0:

```bash
FILES=(
  python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/flashinfer_backend.py
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_flashinfer_multi_item_scoring.py
)
PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_flashinfer_multi_item_scoring.py -f
# PASS: 4 tests.
python -m ruff check --select F401,F821,F823,UP037 "${FILES[@]}"  # PASS
python -m ruff format --check "${FILES[@]}"                    # PASS
python -m isort --check-only "${FILES[@]}"                     # PASS
python -m py_compile "${FILES[@]}"                            # PASS
python scripts/lint/check_registered_tests.py                  # PASS
python scripts/lint/check_no_bare_pytest_main.py "${FILES[@]}"  # PASS
python scripts/lint/check_no_registered_tests_in_package.py    # PASS
git diff upstream/main...HEAD --check                          # PASS
```

</details>

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Same H200/model/runtime, comparing original MIS with this text-position fix only. Synthetic workload: 120-token shared query, ten 180-token items, raw HTTP `/v1/score`, `apply_softmax=false`, concurrency 1. Radix cache, CUDA graphs and chunked prefill are disabled in both versions.

Three 60-second trials per version, ten excluded warmups per trial, interleaved server starts and matched item-order seeds 42/43/44. 

| Mode | Items/s | P50 request latency | P95 request latency |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Original MIS | 149.962167 | 66.459236 ms | 67.840261 ms |
| This position fix | 149.100433 | 66.992680 ms | 68.042503 ms |

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).

- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
- [x] Local code review completed

             token_pos_in_items_ptr.append(pos_within_item.to(torch.uint16))
 
-            forward_batch.positions[seq_start + first_delim : seq_end] = (
+            token_slice = slice(seq_start + first_delim, seq_end)
+            forward_batch.positions[token_slice] = (
                 prefix_len + pos_within_item - 1
             ).to(device, non_blocking=True)
+            if forward_batch.mrope_positions is not None and (
+                forward_batch.mm_inputs is None or forward_batch.mm_inputs[i] is None
+            ):
+                # MRoPE text consumes these axes instead of scalar positions.
+                # Preserve spatial axes and clamp only rotary-cache indices.
+                forward_batch.mrope_positions[:, token_slice] = forward_batch.positions[
+                    token_slice
+                ].clamp_min(0)
 
             seq_start = seq_end

@@ -32,6 +32,8 @@ def _build(
         multi_item_delimiter_indices=delimiters,
         input_ids=torch.zeros(total_tokens, dtype=torch.int64),
         positions=torch.zeros(total_tokens, dtype=torch.int64),
+        mrope_positions=None,
+        mm_inputs=None,
     )
     if seq_lens is not None:
         fb.extend_seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens

@@ -0,0 +1,185 @@
+"""Regression coverage for FlashInfer multi-item scoring positions."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.flashinfer_backend import (  # noqa: E402
+    FlashInferAttnBackend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode  # noqa: E402
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _make_backend(*, enable_mis: bool = True) -> FlashInferAttnBackend:
+    backend = object.__new__(FlashInferAttnBackend)
+    backend.enable_mis = enable_mis
+    return backend
+
+
+def _make_forward_batch(
+    *,
+    seq_lens: list[int],
+    delimiter_indices: list[list[int]] | None,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    mrope_positions: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    mm_inputs: list[object | None] | None = None,
+    prefix_lens: list[int] | None = None,
+    mode: ForwardMode = ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=mode,
+        multi_item_delimiter_indices=(
+            [torch.tensor(indices, dtype=torch.int64) for indices in delimiter_indices]
+            if delimiter_indices is not None
+            else None
+        ),
+        extend_prefix_lens_cpu=(
+            prefix_lens if prefix_lens is not None else [0] * len(seq_lens)
+        ),
+        extend_seq_lens_cpu=seq_lens,
+        input_ids=torch.zeros(sum(seq_lens), dtype=torch.int64),
+        positions=positions,
+        mrope_positions=mrope_positions,
+        mm_inputs=mm_inputs,
+    )
+
+
+class TestFlashInferMultiItemScoringPositions(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_text_mrope_positions_follow_query_relative_item_positions(self):
+        """MRoPE text items must follow the query, not preceding packed items."""
+        batch = _make_forward_batch(
+            seq_lens=[12],
+            delimiter_indices=[[2, 5, 9, 11]],
+            positions=torch.arange(12, dtype=torch.int64),
+            mrope_positions=torch.arange(12, dtype=torch.int64).repeat(3, 1),
+        )
+
+        params = _make_backend()._process_multi_item_scoring(batch)
+
+        self.assertTrue(params.is_enabled())
+        expected = torch.tensor([0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 1])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(batch.positions, expected)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            batch.mrope_positions, expected.unsqueeze(0).expand(3, -1)
+        )
+
+    def test_empty_query_preserves_logical_positions_and_safe_rotary_indices(self):
+        """Only MRoPE cache indices are clamped; logical delimiters stay masked."""
+        for has_mrope in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(has_mrope=has_mrope):
+                batch = _make_forward_batch(
+                    seq_lens=[6],
+                    delimiter_indices=[[0, 3, 5]],
+                    positions=torch.arange(6, dtype=torch.int64),
+                    mrope_positions=(
+                        torch.arange(6, dtype=torch.int64).repeat(3, 1)
+                        if has_mrope
+                        else None
+                    ),
+                )
+
+                params = _make_backend()._process_multi_item_scoring(batch)
+
+                self.assertEqual(batch.positions.tolist(), [-1, 0, 1, -1, 0, -1])
+                if has_mrope:
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        batch.mrope_positions.tolist(), [[0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]] * 3
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self.assertIsNone(batch.mrope_positions)
+                self.assertEqual(params.prefix_len_ptr.tolist(), [0])
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    params.token_pos_in_items_ptr.tolist(), [0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 0]
+                )
+
+                # FlashInfer's causal MIS predicate must exclude delimiter keys.
+                queries = torch.tensor([1, 2, 4])[:, None]
+                keys = torch.arange(6)[None, :]
+                within_item = params.token_pos_in_items_ptr.to(torch.int64)[queries]
+                visible = (keys <= queries) & (
+                    (keys < params.prefix_len_ptr.item())
+                    | (queries < keys + within_item)
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    visible.tolist(),
+                    [
+                        [False, True, False, False, False, False],
+                        [False, True, True, False, False, False],
+                        [False, False, False, False, True, False],
+                    ],
+                )
+
+    def test_mixed_batch_preserves_multimodal_mrope_axes(self):
